entries.title: What it is
entries.content: Purple Star astrology (Jamidusu 자미두수, Chinese Zi Wei Dou Shu) is a sister system to saju. It maps stars onto a 12-palace chart from your lunar birth date and two-hour birth period.
entries.source: Master Sean Chan: BaZi and Zi Wei Dou Shu
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: The 12 palaces
entries.content: Life, Siblings, Spouse, Children, Wealth, Health, Travel, Friends, Career, Property, Mind and Parents. Each palace covers one area of life.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: The 14 main stars
entries.content: Fourteen main stars, led by Zi Wei (the Emperor star), are placed in the palaces. Their mix describes strengths in each area.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Saju vs Purple Star
entries.content: Saju reads elements and timing; Purple Star reads life areas in detail. Many readers use both side by side.
entries.source: Master Sean Chan: BaZi and Zi Wei Dou Shu
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection
